Frequently Asked Questions

Does insurance cover massage therapy in Bellevue?

Some plans may include massage therapy benefits, but coverage is not guaranteed. Coverage and benefits vary by individual insurance plan. Please contact us to verify your massage therapy benefits.

Do you work with Premera, Kaiser or Aetna?

We work with eligible plans from these carriers. Benefits, networks and patient responsibility vary, so we must verify your specific plan before treatment.

Do I need a referral or prior authorization?

Requirements depend on your plan. Benefit verification can help identify whether documentation or authorization is needed before your visit.

What information is needed to verify benefits?

Use our secure benefits form to share the requested plan information. We will review the next steps with you before scheduling insurance massage.
